1: Ezhuthu Kamalam Font Family
2: ===========================
3: 
4: ![Ezhuthu Kamalam — a Malayalam typeface that blooms](proofs/kamalam_hero.png)
5: 
6: **Ezhuthu Kamalam** is a Malayalam display typeface that treats the script's
7: loops as thresholds. Malayalam is a script of round counters and open curls;
8: Kamalam turns each one into a **lotus gateway**. At one end of its variable
9: axis the loop is the classic round form; at the other, its crown rises into a
10: soft petal. The transformation is not a decorative filter — it is a real
11: OpenType variation axis, interpolated from point-compatible outlines.
12: 
13: The family was designed for the large gesture: headlines, wordmarks, posters,
14: title cards, brand systems and screens where Malayalam should feel
15: contemporary without losing its roots. It is also comfortable in text, where
16: the petal crowns settle into a quiet, readable rhythm.
17: 
18: The typeface is built on the **Manjari** skeleton by Santhosh Thottingal and
19: Swathanthra Malayalam Computing, used under the SIL Open Font License. The
20: aperture engine, variable axis, spectrum build, metrics and specimens are new
21: work by the Ezhuthu Project Authors.
22: 
23: The Aperture Axis
24: -----------------
25: 
26: ![The five stops of the aperture axis](proofs/kamalam_axis.png)
27: 
28: Every counter in Ezhuthu Kamalam can open from a classic round loop
29: (`APER 0`) to a pointed lotus gateway (`APER 100`). The axis is exposed as
30: `APER` in the variable fonts and has five named stops:
31: 
32: | APER | Name | Character |
33: |---:|---|---|
34: | 0 | Round | The classic Manjari loop |
35: | 25 | Quarter | A first lift at the crown |
36: | 50 | Bloom | The gateway begins to open |
37: | 75 | Three-quarters | A clear petal silhouette |
38: | 100 | Petal | The full lotus display cut (default) |
39: 
40: ![The aperture axis in motion](proofs/kamalam_aper.gif)
41: 
42: The two masters share the same point topology, so every intermediate value is
43: a designed shape and HarfBuzz shaping is identical at every stop. The axis
44: changes the counters and crowns, never the glyph sequence, the spacing or the
45: kerning.
46: 
47: The Spectrum
48: ------------
49: 
50: ![Ezhuthu Kamalam Spectrum](proofs/kamalam_gradient.png)
51: 
52: **Ezhuthu Kamalam Spectrum** carries a blue → orange gradient inside the font
53: itself with COLRv1 and CPAL. Blue sits at the crown, orange near the baseline
54: and gold in the descenders, so a paragraph reads as one continuous field
55: rather than a set of separately coloured letters. Both Regular and Bold
56: Spectrum builds are included.
57: 
58: The spectrum is an homage to the lotus-and-gateway visual language of
59: [Sarvam AI](https://www.sarvam.ai/brand). This project is independent and is
60: not affiliated with or endorsed by Sarvam AI.

78: ![Ezhuthu Kamalam character sheet](proofs/kamalam_glyphs.png)

80: Ezhuthu Kamalam covers the complete Malayalam block plus Latin:
